title: FBI Photo B12
doc_notes: This document is an FBI report containing a single monochrome sensor still of a UAP, heavily redacted and featuring an unreliable system timestamp.

incidents.summary: A small, dark, circular object was captured in a monochrome infrared or thermal sensor still over mountainous terrain.
incidents.explanation: The operator reported that they were unable to positively identify the UAP.
incidents.quote: A small, distinct, dark anomalous object is visible in the upper-right quadrant of the reticle
